about.title: About us
about.first: We started with a simple belief: the things in your home should carry a little of the hands that made them. Today we work with craftspeople across India to bring lighting, wall décor and accents into homes that value detail.
about.second: Every piece is chosen for how it is made and how it lives in a room. We test, photograph and pack each order ourselves, so what arrives at your door is exactly what you fell in love with.
